title: Magnetic Flux Formula
text: Magnetic flux (phi) = B * A, where B is magnetic field strength and A is the cross-sectional area. The change in flux depends on how B changes.

title: Calculate Change
text: Change in B = 0.1 - 0.4 = -0.3 T. Change in flux = A * (change in B) = 0.05 * (-0.3) = -0.015 Wb
